breakdown.description: Viscosity units are inconsistent: 1.0e-3 m^2/s is not a dynamic viscosity; it's closer to a kinematic viscosity with the wrong magnitude.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error verbatim, stating 'The dynamic viscosity mu is 1.0e-3 m^2/s.' The units m^2/s are units of kinematic viscosity (nu), not dynamic viscosity (mu). The ground truth specifies that mu ≈ 1.0e-3 Pa·s and nu ≈ 1.0e-6 m²/s. The agent failed to identify or correct this inconsistency.
